The disclosed 2-rule screen requires gross margin at least 40% and reported revenue growth at least 0%; only the margin rule passes. The source says higher discounts and channel mix pressured gross margin, partly offset by lower input and logistics costs.

The selected table does not state a line-item cause for that margin decline. A two-rule historical screen requires gross margin at least 40% and reported revenue growth at least 0%.

AMD Q3 2024 SEC exhibit: GAAP revenue USD 6,819 million, GAAP gross margin 50%, Gaming revenue USD 462 million. Baseline Q2 2024 was revenue USD 5,835 million, gross margin 49%, Gaming revenue USD 648 million. Q2 and Q3 are adjacent. A single Gaming decline does not establish sustained segment weakness.
